business_overview.one_sentence: The group operates PRC healthcare services including hospital services, rehabilitation and other healthcare services, and elderly healthcare services.

segments.business_substance: Inpatient healthcare, outpatient healthcare and physical examination services.
segments.source: Annual Report 2023, notes to financial statements, revenue disaggregation, p.219

segments.business_substance: Rehabilitation hospital, rehabilitation centres and other healthcare services.
segments.source: Annual Report 2023, notes to financial statements, revenue disaggregation, p.219
Annual Report 2023, notes to financial statements, revenue disaggregation, p.219

business_overview.revenue_model: Healthcare services are recognised over time as services are rendered; patients pay by cash, card, mobile payment or PRC social insurance schemes, with social insurance settlement generally 30 to 180 days after transaction date.
business_notes: Kangxin Hospital continued to operate at negative gross margin during 2023, although revenue improved.
Kanghua Qingxi Healthcare Complex construction began in 2021 and remains a capital commitment context for cash use.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Investment return mainly from PRC bank structured deposits.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Fair value movement of FVTPL financial assets.
Interest income on bank and other balances.

funds_assets.business_substance: Cash and cash equivalents at year end; PRC operating group cash not split by parent/subsidiary in the report.
funds_assets.source: Annual Report 2023, consolidated cash flow statement and note 21, pp.178, 247

funds_assets.business_substance: Fixed bank deposits with original maturity over three months and fixed annual interest rate of 5.3%.
PRC commercial bank structured deposits with variable investment returns; majority maturities less than six months and generally renewed at maturity.
Deposits required by Dongguan Social Insurance Bureau, IPO proceeds in PRC banks requiring approval for specified usage, and fixed-term guarantee deposit.

operating_assets.business_substance: Receivables include patient, corporate and PRC social insurance settlement balances.
Hospitals, medical equipment and construction assets used for healthcare operations.
operating_assets.source: Annual Report 2023, statement of financial position, p.174

operating_assets.business_substance: Leasehold land and leased properties used in hospital operations.
operating_assets.source: Annual Report 2023, statement of financial position and note 15, pp.174, 234

investment_assets.business_substance: Seven-year PRC medical services/biotech/medical equipment/informatics fund investing in unlisted companies.

other_assets.business_substance: Goodwill allocated to Anhui Hualin CGU; Kangxin Hospital goodwill previously fully impaired.
Brand introduction fee for Kangxin Hospital management arrangement, amortised over service period.
other_assets.source: Annual Report 2023, note 19 and accounting judgement, pp.210, 245

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Secured bank/fixed-rate financing liabilities used for Kangxin Hospital Phase II, Kanghua Qingxi Healthcare Complex and medical equipment sale-and-leaseback financing.
IFRS 16 operating property lease liabilities, current and non-current.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Reported operating cash flow is above parent net profit in 2021-2023, but hospitals and new healthcare complexes require continuing equipment/property capex, lease payments and social-insurance receivable funding. 2023 PP&E cash purchase was RMB98.257 million and PPE deposits were RMB32.628 million; only part is treated as maintenance, with remaining expansion capex captured by the profit haircut and cash limitations.

evidence.source: HKEX title search for stock code 03689

gaps: The annual report does not split bank balances and cash by listed parent, Hong Kong entity, PRC operating subsidiary and IPO-designated account.
The annual report discloses restricted bank balances categories but not the exact balance for each restricted category.
The annual report does not disclose maintenance capex separately from expansion capex.

The 2023 annual fact pack uses the 2023 annual report as the primary source; 2021 operating cash flow is taken from the HKEX 2021 annual report indexed text and should be re-extracted if a full 2021 fact pack is later required.
